inputs.text: a single ground shockwave blasts outward from a point of impact, a torn ragged ring of fire and dust that starts as a tight bright knot at the centre and rips outward across the ground, its leading edge a hot gold-white rim of flame with molten orange billowing behind it and dark embers and grit thrown up along the way, the ring is thick, uneven and broken, never a clean geometric circle, as it widens it thins and tears apart, the flame dies down to embers, the embers wink out one by one and the frame is black again, painted 3D mobile-RPG game art, semi-realistic fantasy magic, rich and ornate, high contrast against a dark ground, no flat cartoon shading, no anime line art, molten orange and ember red with a hot gold-white leading edge, saturated luminous fire colour, translucent soft glow, seen from above at a steep angle so the ring reads as a flat disc on the ground, perfectly centred, the ring starts tiny at the exact centre of the frame, pure black background, nothing else in the shot, nothing lit except the shockwave itself, the frame is completely black on the first frame and completely black again on the last frame, one single beat: it expands once and clears once, no second ring, no repeat, locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no parallax, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo
